name: 财报锦囊
tagline: One US ticker in, a seven-point Chinese skim of the newest earnings out
description: Name a US-listed ticker and it gathers the newest quarter's numbers, the analyst consensus going in, how guidance shifted, and the highlights of the earnings call. The result is a seven-point readout written in Chinese, built for a fast skim rather than a deep dive. It stops short of telling you what to trade.
author: kaixinluo6268
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
